'''[[Jinn Reeso]]'s [[Podracer/Legends|Podracer]]''' featured a distinctive black and white paint scheme and a pair of exceptionally large engines. It was often the favorite whenever it was entered at the [[Mon Gazza/Legends|Mon Gazza]] [[Spice Mine Run]] race.

{{Veh-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
This Pod was only selectable for play if the player entered the code '''RRJINNRE''' or '''RRTANGENTABACUS''' for the N64 version of [[Star Wars: Episode I Racer|Star Wars Episode I: Racer]]. Upon entry, Jinn fully replaces [[Mars Guo/Legends|Mars Guo]].
[[File:JinnAndRummy-E1R.png|thumb|left|200px|Jinn Reeso on the starting line at the [[Ando Prime Centrum/Legends|Ando Prime Centrum]] Invitational]]
